cards.front: Póngame con el Sr. García; necesito hablar con él urgentemente.
cards.back: Get me Mr Garcia; I need to talk to him urgently.

cards.front: ¿Cuál es la manera más fácil de contactar contigo?
cards.back: What's the easiest way to get you?

cards.front: He estado intentando hablar contigo desde hace siglos.
cards.back: I've been trying to get you for ages.

cards.front: Creo que me la voy a cargar.
cards.back: I think they're out to get me.

cards.front: Siente que todo el mundo va contra él.
cards.back: He feels that everyone is out to get him.

cards.front: ¡Esto nos lo vas a pagar!
cards.back: We'll get you for that!

cards.front: ¿Quieres que le pida que te ayude?
cards.back: Do you want me to get him to help you?

cards.front: ¡Dile que vuelva en seguida!
cards.back: Get him to come straight back!

cards.front: Nunca la vas a convencer de que se ponga ese vestido.
cards.back: You'll never get her to wear that dress.

cards.front: Leer ese artículo me hizo pensar en ti.
cards.back: When I read that article it got me thinking about you.

cards.front: ¿Qué le hizo saltar?
cards.back: What got him going?

cards.front: Esta canción siempre hace bailar a todo el mundo.
cards.back: This song always gets everybody dancing.

cards.front: ¿Puedes hacer funcionar este ordenador para mí?
cards.back: Can you get this computer working for me?

cards.front: Este tío ha hecho que el equipo funcione de verdad.
cards.back: This guy has really got the team playing well.

cards.front: ¡Vamos a hacer que esta fiesta se anime!
cards.back: Let's get this party going!

cards.front: ¿Cómo te llevas con tus suegros?
cards.back: How do you get on with your parents-in-law?

cards.front: No me llevo muy bien con mi novio últimamente.
cards.back: I haven't been getting along very well with my boyfriend lately.

cards.front: ¡Nos llevamos de maravilla!
cards.back: We get on like a house on fire!

cards.front: ¡Esto no va a quedar así!
cards.back: You won't get away with this!

cards.front: ¿Cómo es posible que permitan que los banqueros se lleven tanto dinero?
cards.back: How can bankers get away with earning all that money?

cards.front: No podemos dejar que salgan impunes.
cards.back: We can't let them get away with it.

cards.front: ¿Sabes suficiente inglés para salir del paso durante tus vacaciones?
cards.back: Do you know enough English to get by on your holidays?

cards.front: ¡No soy ningún Ferran Adrià, pero me defiendo en la cocina!
cards.back: I'm no Ferran Adria, but I can get by in the kitchen!

cards.front: No sé cómo se las arreglan; ninguno de los dos tiene trabajo.
cards.back: I don't know how they get by; neither of them has a job.

cards.front: Le está costando mucho superar que su mujer le haya dejado.
cards.back: He's finding it difficult to get over his wife leaving him.

cards.front: Ha vencido su timidez de una vez por todas, ¿a que sí?
cards.back: She's really got over her shyness, hasn't she?

cards.front: ¿Todavía no te has repuesto de la gripe?
cards.back: Haven't you got over your flu yet?

cards.front: ¿Está él intentando librarse de esta clase de formación también?
cards.back: Is he trying to get out of this training session as well?

cards.front: ¡Esta vez no te vas a librar de limpiar la casa!
cards.back: You're not going to get out of cleaning the house this time!

cards.front: ¿Cómo vas a salir de ésta, listillo?
cards.back: How are you going to get out of this one, smarty pants?

cards.front: ¡Deshazte de ese chicle antes de que entre el jefe!
cards.back: Get rid of that chewing gum before the boss comes in!

cards.front: Pensaba que se había quitado de encima hace siglos a ese novio tan tonto.
cards.back: I thought she'd got rid of that stupid boyfriend of hers ages ago.

cards.front: Me pregunto cómo podremos eliminar este olor del cuarto de baño.
cards.back: I wonder how we can get rid of this smell from the bathroom.

cards.front: ¿Sabes dónde puedo conseguir hierbaluisa?
cards.back: Do you know where I could get hold of some lemongrass?

cards.front: Nunca logro pillarle; su secretaria siempre dice que está reunido.
cards.back: I can never get hold of him; his secretary always says he's in a meeting.

cards.front: ¿Dónde puedo conseguir ese disco?
cards.back: Where can I get hold of that record?

cards.front: No queremos dejar que la competencia se entere de esta idea.
cards.back: We don't want to let the competition get wind of this idea.

cards.front: ¿Te has enterado de la decisión de la dirección?
cards.back: Have you got wind of the management's decision?

cards.front: Si tu mujer se entera, ¡te matará!
cards.back: If your wife gets wind of this, she'll kill you!

cards.front: No me puedo creer que todavía no hayas cogido el truco a este mando.
cards.back: I can't believe you still haven't got the hang of this remote control.

cards.front: Vaya que si le has cogido el truco a este juego, ¿verdad?
cards.back: You've really got the hang of this game, haven't you?

cards.front: Nunca le cogí el truco al tango, por eso dejé de asistir a las clases.
cards.back: I never could get the hang of the tango, that's why I stopped going to the classes.

cards.front: ¿Captaste lo esencial de lo que te dijo ella?
cards.back: Did you get the gist of what she said?

cards.front: Él habla tan rápido que ni siquiera puedo entender el sentido de lo que dice.
cards.back: He speaks so fast that I can't even get the gist of what he says.

cards.front: No tienes que entender cada palabra; sólo tienes que comprender lo esencial.
cards.back: You don't have to understand every word; you just need to get the gist.

cards.front: Ella es muy tímida; es difícil tirarle de la lengua.
cards.back: She's really shy; it's difficult to get a word out of her.

cards.front: No le vas a sacar ni una palabra.
cards.back: You won't get a word out of him.

cards.front: No me salían las palabras.
cards.back: I couldn't get the words out.

cards.front: Es una jefa genial; siempre logra sacar lo mejor de sus empleados.
cards.back: She's a great boss; she always manages to get the best out of her employees.

cards.front: Como persona es horrible, pero como entrenador es fantástico porque siempre saca lo mejor de sus jugadores.
cards.back: As a person he's horrible, but as a coach he's fantastic because he always gets the best out of his players.

cards.front: Yo era un estudiante difícil, pero mi profesor de Física, el Sr. Gibson, sabía cómo sacar lo mejor de mí.
cards.back: I was a difficult student, but my physics teacher, Mr Gibson, knew how to get the best out of me.

cards.front: La expresión de su cara es lo que no consigo quitarme de la cabeza.
cards.back: It's the expression he had on his face that I can't get out of my mind.

cards.front: Tienes que sacártela de la cabeza; de lo contrario te va a resultar imposible salir con otra persona.
cards.back: You have to get her out of your mind; otherwise it's going to be impossible for you to go out with somebody else.

cards.front: ¿No fue Kylie Minogue quien cantó lo de «I just can't get you out of my head»?
cards.back: Wasn't it Kylie Minogue who sang "I just can't get you out of my head"?

cards.front: La fiesta se descontroló anoche.
cards.back: Things got out of hand last night at the party.

cards.front: No dejes que las cosas se te vayan de las manos otra vez.
cards.back: Don't let things get out of hand again.

cards.front: Sólo fue una mentira piadosa: no me podía imaginar que las cosas se fuesen a descontrolar tanto.
cards.back: It was only a white lie; I couldn't have imagined that things would get so out of hand.

cards.front: Ojalá él quitara la cabeza de en medio; no veo la pantalla.
cards.back: I wish he'd get his big head out of the way; I can't see the screen.

cards.front: Quítense de en medio, por favor. El coche de la reina está a punto de pasar.
cards.back: Can you get out of the way, please? The queen's car is about to pass by.

cards.front: ¡Quítate de en medio, tonto!
cards.back: Get out of the way, you fool!

cards.front: ¿Cuándo tendremos la oportunidad de probar el nuevo sistema?
cards.back: When do we get to try the new system?

cards.front: Tendréis oportunidad de escuchar mi nuevo disco pronto.
cards.back: You'll get to listen to my new record soon.

cards.front: ¿Por qué nunca tenemos la oportunidad de conocer a tu novia?
cards.back: Why don't we ever get to meet your girlfriend?

cards.front: Llegamos a conocernos bien cuando trabajamos juntos el verano pasado.
cards.back: We really got to know each other when we worked together last summer.

cards.front: Lo más frustrante es que nunca llegaremos a saber por qué lo hicieron.
cards.back: The most frustrating thing is that we'll never get to know why they did it.

cards.front: Por mucho tiempo que pase con él nunca tengo la sensación de conocerle.
cards.back: No matter how much time I spend with him, I never get the feeling that I'm getting to know him.

cards.front: ¿Lograsteis ir al backstage después para conocer al grupo?
cards.back: Did you get to go backstage afterwards and meet the band?

cards.front: Logramos hablar con el Primer Ministro después de su discurso.
cards.back: We got to speak to the Prime Minister at the end of his speech.

cards.front: ¿Alguna vez lograste convencerle de que estaba equivocado?
cards.back: Did you ever get to convince him that he was wrong?

cards.front: ¿Has hecho progresos con tus investigaciones en el caso Barnum?
cards.back: Have you got anywhere with your research into the Barnum case?

cards.front: No entiendo a dónde quieres llegar con todo esto.
cards.back: I don't understand where you're trying to get with all of this.

cards.front: Dejémoslo para mañana porque ahora no estamos llegando a ninguna parte.
cards.back: Let's leave it until tomorrow because we're not getting anywhere at the moment.

cards.front: Dejad de hablar y seguid trabajando.
cards.back: Stop talking and get on with it!

cards.front: Olvidémonos de todo eso y pongámonos con ello.
cards.back: Let's forget about all that stuff and just get on with it.

cards.front: ¡Venga! ¡Ponte con ello!
cards.back: Come on! Get on with it!

cards.front: Vale, tranquilo, no es algo por lo que haya que alterarse demasiado.
cards.back: Alright, calm down, it's not something to get worked up about.

cards.front: ¿Por qué te estás poniendo tan nerviosa?
cards.back: What are you getting so worked up about?

cards.front: No se lo cuentes, sólo le vas a alterar.
cards.back: Don't tell him, he'll just get worked up.

cards.front: Me entusiasmé demasiado cantando anoche en el karaoke.
cards.back: I got a bit carried away last night when I was singing at the karaoke.

cards.front: No se lo menciones a él; sabes cómo se deja llevar por sus locos planes de inversión.
cards.back: Don't mention it to him; you know how he gets carried away with his crazy investment plans.

cards.front: ¿Vas a pedirle que se case contigo? ¿No crees que te estás dejando llevar un poco?
cards.back: You're going to ask her to marry you?! Aren't you getting a bit carried away?

cards.front: Creo que me estás confundiendo con otra persona.
cards.back: I think you're getting me muddled up with somebody else.

cards.front: Me puse tan nervioso que no hacía más que confundirme al hablar.
cards.back: I got so nervous that I kept getting my words muddled up.

cards.front: No mezcles esos papeles con los documentos originales.
cards.back: Don't get those papers muddled up with the original documents.

cards.front: Perdona que llegue tarde; cogí un atasco.
cards.back: Sorry I'm late; I got stuck in traffic.

cards.front: No crees que el ascensor se ha quedado atascado, ¿no?
cards.back: You don't think this lift has got stuck, do you?

cards.front: Tuve que aguantar a Norman durante toda la cena de anoche.
cards.back: I got stuck with Norman at the dinner all evening.

cards.front: ¡Me las pagarás por eso!
cards.back: I'll get even with you for that!

cards.front: Él siempre se vengaba de quien hiciera daño a su familia.
cards.back: He always got even with anybody who hurt his family.

cards.front: Ella prometió que se vengaría de él y eso es justo lo que hizo.
cards.back: She promised she would get even with him and that's exactly what she did.
